packages/adapters/src/runs/tools/run-too.name: Tool audit events
packages/adapters/src/runs/tools/run-too.description: Writes a tool.call audit event for a bot's denied or reviewed tool calls.

packages/adapters/src/runs/tools/run-too.name: Auto review runner
packages/adapters/src/runs/tools/run-too.description: Sends a gated call and the owner's words to the reviewer chain and stores its verdict on the effect.

packages/adapters/src/runs/tools/run-too.name: Owner computer gate
packages/adapters/src/runs/tools/run-too.description: Limits the owner's own computer tools to their runs and asks for approval per app or shell.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/tools/p.name: Nameless call repair
packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/tools/p.description: Drops tool calls with empty names from transcripts before a provider rejects the whole conversation.

packages/adapters/src/tools/builtin.tool.name: Built-in tool list
packages/adapters/src/tools/builtin.tool.description: Collects the built-in tool definitions and defines the find_tool and use_tool bridge and computer-mode switches.

packages/adapters/src/tools/lazy-tool-ca.name: Lazy tool catalog
packages/adapters/src/tools/lazy-tool-ca.description: Exposes large connector tool sets through search, load and execute meta-tools instead of listing every schema.

packages/adapters/src/tools/workspace-fi.name: Workspace file tools
packages/adapters/src/tools/workspace-fi.description: Reads, lists and writes files in a bot's workspace using resolved workspace paths.

packages/adapters/src/approvals/auto-rev.name: Auto review core
packages/adapters/src/approvals/auto-rev.description: Configures the approval-model checker, redacts arguments and parses the pass, ask or error verdict.

packages/adapters/src/approvals/auto-rev.name: Auto review prompts
packages/adapters/src/approvals/auto-rev.description: Defines the reviewer's pass and ask rubrics for new sites, lasting writes and own-computer actions.

packages/adapters/src/approvals/approval.name: Approval card builder
packages/adapters/src/approvals/approval.description: Builds the bounded, escaped approval card block shown to the owner for a held tool call.

packages/adapters/src/approvals/approval.name: Approval effect replay
packages/adapters/src/approvals/approval.description: Binds approved calls to stored effects for replay and settles duplicate or uncertain effects.

packages/adapters/src/mcp/mcp-tool-permi.name: MCP tool allow-list
packages/adapters/src/mcp/mcp-tool-permi.description: Checks whether an MCP server assignment permits a given tool name.

packages/adapters/src/mcp/mcp-connector..name: MCP connector
packages/adapters/src/mcp/mcp-connector..description: Runs MCP servers over stdio or remote transports with OAuth, discovery and per-assignment tool filtering.

packages/adapters/src/mcp/mcp-connector..name: MCP catalog groups
packages/adapters/src/mcp/mcp-connector..description: Groups MCP tools for the catalog and supplies an unavailable placeholder tool when a server fails.

packages/adapters/src/mcp/mcp-package-in.name: MCP package installer
packages/adapters/src/mcp/mcp-package-in.description: Installs npm stdio MCP servers once into a managed directory and launches the installed binary.

packages/adapters/src/mcp/mcp-response-l.name: MCP response cap
packages/adapters/src/mcp/mcp-response-l.description: Fails MCP response bodies that grow past 16 MB before the SDK buffers them.

packages/adapters/src/providers/computer.name: Desktop command guard
packages/adapters/src/providers/computer.description: Refuses shell commands that would kill or modify processes and files shared on the desktop.

packages/adapters/src/providers/computer.name: Guard refusal text
packages/adapters/src/providers/computer.description: Provides the message returned when the desktop command guard blocks a command.

packages/adapters/src/computers/host/hos.name: Host computer client
packages/adapters/src/computers/host/hos.description: Sends bounded, authenticated, never-retried requests to the owner's desktop app for local commands and files.

packages/adapters/src/computers/host/use.name: User computer tool names
packages/adapters/src/computers/host/use.description: Names the owner-computer tools and normalizes the app name shown on approval cards.

packages/adapters/src/computers/sandbox/.name: Sandbox allowance
packages/adapters/src/computers/sandbox/.description: Computes sandbox hour cost against the plan allowance, treating user-machine computers as free.

packages/adapters/src/computers/sandbox/.name: Sandbox kind capabilities
packages/adapters/src/computers/sandbox/.description: Looks up what each computer kind supports, such as native shell, screen and running on the user's machine.

packages/adapters/src/providers/computer.name: Docker sandbox
packages/adapters/src/providers/computer.description: Implements the sandbox provider interface on Docker containers; only its imports were skimmed.

packages/adapters/src/secrets/vault/vaul.name: Vault redaction forms
packages/adapters/src/secrets/vault/vaul.description: Builds the redaction strings for passwords, one-time codes, API keys and cards so they never reach outputs.

packages/adapters/src/secrets/run-secret.name: Run secret handling
packages/adapters/src/secrets/run-secret.description: Pauses runs for protected secret entry and consumes single-use secrets before side effects.

packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/run-.name: Run context and taint
packages/adapters/src/runs/assembly/run-.description: Holds per-run state and tracks whether outside content has tainted the run.
